payload.title: Extract the email renderer into a small shared package
payload.description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** One renderer for Papyrus mail and notifications. `papyrus_content.email_render` is pure Python except that it calls Markus for the body, through `papyrus_content.markus_renderer`, which shells out to the `markus` binary.

**Build.**
- New package `packages/email-render` in this repo, MIT, published from CI as `caducus-email-render`: `theme.py`, `dom.py`, `styles.py`, `text.py`, `urls.py`, and `render.py` changed to take an HTML fragment, not Markus.
- `src/caducus/notify/render/` builds a fragment from event facts (title, dek, link). Papyrus keeps Markus conversion and calls the package (P_RENDER).
- Keep `email_render_test.py` tests with the code; the rule that a theme with no branding renders the same stays pinned.

**Acceptance.**
All existing renderer tests pass in the new package; no `markus` import there.

**Related:** P_RENDER
